messages:
vivian: Heads-up: planning a staggered cross-service push tonight in the 00:30-02:00 UTC window. Services: api@3.4.1, runtime@2.16.0, router@1.10.1, console@0.24.2. Need a hard pin to avoid asymmetric rollouts.

vivian: Short rationale: runtime has a GC tuning change that affects eviction under bursty load; router has small header routing improvement; api has client auth harmonization; console has UI telemetry opt-in behind flag.

deploy-bot: preflight started for release 3.4.1/2.16.0/1.10.1/0.24.2 (initiated by @vivian). Checking compatibility and pins...

deploy-bot: preflight result: schema OK. Pinned variants proposed: api=3.4.1 runtime=2.16.0 router=1.10.1 console=0.24.2. No DB migrations.

omar: rollback triggers? I recommend explicit KV eviction alert threshold + api auth error spike.

tess: agreed. Suggest: abort if 5m sustained p50 > 2.5x baseline OR error-rate >1.5% on any production route, OR KV eviction rate >0.4% for 3m.

sre-oncall: I'll be present 00:15-02:15 UTC. If we need to stop, steps: 1) orchctl pause <job>; 2) orchctl pin to previous variants; 3) evac canaries. I'll coordinate.

vivian: rollout order proposal:    (1) api canary 2% per-region -> wait 8m;    (2) runtime canary 1% -> wait 8m;    (3) router canary 2% -> wait 12m verification -> console paused/manual flip.

platform: reserving window and opening #incidents link. Support: @tess first hour, @omar second hour.

deploy-bot: orchestrator job created: orch-7370000000. Canary plan attached.

omar: please include quick revert lines in runbook.

vivian: added short rollback snippet: orchctl pause orch-7370000000 && orchctl pin api=3.4.0 runtime=2.15.9 router=1.10.0 console=0.24.1 && ops-run smoke api runtime router

tess: adding a 15m telemetry verification after router ramp to ensure APM traces and correlation keys look correct.

sre-oncall: confirm alerts wired: grafana panels for api p50/p95, runtime memory growth, router header mismatch, and KV eviction.

vivian: confirmed. Also adding a post-release 48h hold on auto-roll for the console collector flag. Manual flip only.

deploy-bot: preflight success. Orchestrator scheduled to start 2026-03-24T00:35:00Z. Will post progress here.

omar: I'll post gate metrics as they come.

tess: support note posted to #incidents with escalation path.

sre-oncall: standby confirmed.

vivian: Thanks team  let's keep channel clear during the window and only post gate check summaries. Good luck.

deploy-bot: orchestrator started: orch-7370000000. Progress updates will follow.
